# SemanticLakehouse.com

> SemanticLakehouse.com is an educational platform dedicated to Data Lakehouses, the Semantic Layer, Agentic Analytics, and Query Federation, with a focus on Dremio's unified engine-catalog-semantic layer approach.

## Structure
- [Home](https://semanticlakehouse.com/): Home page defining core concepts.
- [Blog](https://semanticlakehouse.com/blog): Directory of blogs aggregated from datalakehousehub.com.
- [Reading](https://semanticlakehouse.com/reading): Recommended books on Data and AI authored by Alex Merced.
- [Knowledge Base](https://semanticlakehouse.com/knowledge-base): A comprehensive dictionary of data engineering and analytics terms.

## Author

Created and maintained by [Alex Merced](https://whoisalexmerced.com), Head of Developer Relations at Dremio and O'Reilly/Manning author.

- [WhoIsAlexMerced.com](https://whoisalexmerced.com): About Alex Merced.
- [AlexMerced.com](https://alexmerced.com): Personal hub and links.
- [AlexMercedData.com](https://alexmerceddata.com): Data content and resources.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexmerced): Professional profile.
- [@alexmercedcoder on Twitter/X](https://twitter.com/alexmercedcoder): Social profile.

## Related Properties

- [DataEngr.com](https://dataengnr.com): Data engineering knowledge base (Apache Iceberg, lakehouse, AI).
- [AgenticLakehouse.com](https://agenticlakehouse.com): Knowledge hub on agentic lakehouses and agentic analytics.
- [Books by Alex Merced](https://books.alexmerced.com): O'Reilly and Manning titles.
